# Light pollution

City light washes out faint objects. A dark site far from streetlamps shows the Milky Way as a band of cloud; a town shows only the brightest stars. A Bortle scale number between 1 and 9 rates how dark a sky is, and a nebula that is invisible at 7 can be striking at 3. Plan trips for the new moon.
